import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('C:\\AI\\benchmark\\v2\\results-v3\\sandboxes\\pawn__off\\sql-net-satis\\magaza.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Net satış ve net ciro hesaplaması sorgusu
query = """
WITH net_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id as urun_id,
        u.ad as urun_adi,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.siparis_kalemleri.birim_fiyat IS NOT NULL THEN s.siparis_kalemleri.adet - COALESCE(i.adet, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) as net_adet
    FROM urunler u
    LEFT JOIN siparisler s ON u.id = s.musteri_id
    LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON u.id = sk.urun_id AND s.id = sk.siparis_id
    LEFT JOIN iadeler i ON u.id = i.urun_id AND s.id = i.siparis_id
    GROUP BY u.id, u.ad
),
net_ciro AS (
    SELECT 
        net_sales.*,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sk.birim_fiyat IS NOT NULL AND (sk.adet - COALESCE(i.adet, 0)) > 0 THEN sk.birim_fiyat * (sk.adet - COALESCE(i.adet, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) as net_ciro
    FROM net_sales net
    LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON net.urun_id = sk.urun_id AND net.musteri_id = sk.siparis_id
    LEFT JOIN iadeler i ON net.urun_id = i.urun_id AND net.musteri_id = i.siparis_id
)
SELECT 
    urun_adi,
    net_adet,
    ROUND(net_ciro, 2) as net_ciro
FROM net_ciro
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;
"""

cursor.execute(query)
result = cursor.fetchall()

print("Net satış ve net ciro sorgusu sonucu:")
for row in result:
    print(row)

conn.close()

cursor = conn.cursor()

# Tüm verileri çekip işle - siparis_kalemlerinde sadece birim_fiyat var
query = """
SELECT 
    u.id as urun_id,
    u.ad as urun_adi,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.siparis_kalemleri.birim_fiyat IS NOT NULL THEN s.siparis_kalemleri.birim_fiyat * (s.siparis_kalemleri.adet - COALESCE(i.adet, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) as net_ciro
FROM urunler u
LEFT JOIN siparisler s ON u.id = s.musteri_id
LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON u.id = sk.urun_id AND s.id = sk.siparis_id
LEFT JOIN iadeler i ON u.id = i.urun_id AND s.id = i.siparis_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.ad
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC;
"""

cursor.execute(query)
result = cursor.fetchall()

print("Net satış ve net ciro sorgusu sonucu:")
for row in result:
    print(row)

conn.close()","timeout":120}
